_about: Hand corrections for days where words from the printed commentary (publication titles) got mixed into the scripture. Each entry replaces the verse text for that date.

2026-01-16.t: The vision is yet for its appointed time.

2026-03-27.t: Their hearts continued dull in understanding.

2026-08-14.t: Each one is tried by being drawn out and enticed by his own desire.

2026-12-14.t: Clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because God opposes the haughty ones, but he gives undeserved kindness to the humble ones.
